liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The//Band** (1 review): Reviewer praises the killer Playing In The Band performance from the first set [11]
- **Mind Left Body Jam** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Mind Left Body Jam stunning, marking the start of the show for them [14]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the Let It Grow into Goin' Down The Road transition as a must-hear [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-10-25.136695.sbd.sirmick.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1973-10-25.sbd.unknown.9213.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it one of the best Mind Left Body jams they have heard; Dark Star is described as delicate, spacey, and hanging on the wispiest of threads; The recording's sound quality is noted as being a bit thin [9][12][13]
- **gd1973-10-25.set2.sbd.cribbs.29668.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 103 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: The Dark Star jam is described as minimalist, noisy, unmelodic, and disappointing [17]
- **gd1973-10-25.set2.sbd.cribbs.34837.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 103 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer claims this is their favorite Dark Star from the tour, preferring it over the Oklahoma City version [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-10-25.136695.sbd.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (44.1k) [1]. Also: The tape was provided by an anonymous source with clicks removed and levels adjusted [1]
- **gd1973-10-25.sbd.unknown.9213.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by unknown; source: SBD Master Reel > ? > DAT > CD-R > EAC (secure) > SHN [2]
- **gd1973-10-25.set2.sbd.cribbs.29668.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: Original source: http://db.etree.org/shninfo_detail.php?shnid=188 [3]. Also: Sean Cribbs patched and re-tracked the disc in July 2003, adding crossfades and removing static [3]
- **gd1973-10-25.set2.sbd.cribbs.34837.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: MSR > D > CD > EAC > WAV > CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC [4]. Also: The file was EAC'd from an audio copy of shnid 29668 by Sean Cribbs in May 2006 [4]
